{{Top|leg}}
A '''terend council''' was a part of [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] society. When the tribes were indentured into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]], the terend councils were abolished, but the tribes involved in the construction of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]&mdash;the [[Botrut]], [[Irden]], and [[Isced]]&mdash;re-established the terend councils when granted their freedom.
